value.answer: This needs emergency care now - go to the ER or call 911. Fever with neck stiffness and light sensitivity together needs urgent checking, not watching at home.
value.triage: Go to the ER right away, or call 911 immediately if there's also a rash that doesn't fade when pressed with a glass, drowsiness, confusion, or trouble waking. This is not a wait-and-see case, so skip 811 and act now.
